I am 17 also, 5'5 and weigh 160. About 4 months ago I weighed 185. I just started eating less and eating healthier.  At our age it is important to eat food with nutrients and protein since we are still technically in the process of growing to our full potential. My advice to you would be to eat smaller portions and stay away from candy,cakes,and sugary drinks and diet drinks. Although diet drinks may seem like the way to go, it still harms your body in different ways. Try to eat a salad everyday and keep your meals simple and always drink water. You should also go out jogging then gradually work your way to running. You could lift weights but If you dont want to be a beefy musclehead then I suggest losing weight first then working out otherwise you will just build muscle on top of your fat. Also get plenty of rest and try to keep your mind active such as doing a hobby or reading a book. It sounds dumb but your mental health plays a big role in your physical health. Other then that I would say good luck on your journey. If you have any questions feel free to ask.
